title: Architecture and design patterns
subtitle: Understand the dependency boundaries and why each seam exists.
goal: Keep responsibilities separate enough to change and test
intro: Architecture is useful when it makes one change or failure easier to contain.
terms: Depending on contracts rather than concrete implementations
flow: Typed matches or an explicit failure
case: Replace a database-backed search adapter without rewriting the whole API.
The caller relies on the result contract rather than driver details.
Different backends may not support the same filters or transactions.
